title: Underground cavern on Mars with wiring and a bright red light that went out

tellings.quote: when we first caught this on Mars it was a bright red light right here

plain: A guest named Joe McMoneagle says there is an underground cavern on Mars with wiring inside and a bright red light, which later went out. He points to where the light was on mapping negatives from JPL, the lab that runs NASA's Mars missions, saying that 'when we first caught this on Mars it was a bright red light right here'. If true, it would mean someone built something under the Martian surface.
